story: story-029 (stable reward banking) + story-027 (promo banking) unclaimable-bank accounting

invariants.name: invariant_stableBankConservation / property_stableConservation
invariants.description: totalUnclaimableStable == sum over users of unclaimableStableOf[user]. Tracked total never drifts from per-user sums across stake/withdraw/claim/collect/pull sequences.

invariants.name: invariant_promoBankConservation / property_promoConservation
invariants.description: totalUnclaimableOf[promo] == sum over users of unclaimablePromoOf[promo][user] across normal claim banking AND batchClaim flush banking.

invariants.name: invariant_stableBankSolvency / property_stableSolvency
invariants.description: rewardToken.balanceOf(phlimbo) >= totalUnclaimableStable. Banked stable is physically retained (its transfer failed) and never redistributed to other stakers; if it were paid out to anyone else the contract balance would fall below the bank.

invariants.name: invariant_promoBankSolvency / property_promoSolvency
invariants.description: promoToken.balanceOf(phlimbo) >= totalUnclaimableOf[promo]. Banked promo reserved from finalizePromotion sweep, never redistributed.

invariants.name: invariant_principalSafety / property_principalSafety
invariants.description: With a recipient-blocklisting reward/promo token, withdraw still succeeds and returns full principal. A revert for a staked, reward-blocked actor would be the M-05 regression.

invariants.name: invariant_pullExactness / property_pullExactness
invariants.description: When a banked (then-unblocked) staker pulls via claimUnclaimableStable/claimUnclaimablePromo they receive EXACTLY what was banked - no more (drain funded by others' principal), no less (silent loss); the per-user entry zeroes to 0.

antiVacuityControls: Reward + promo tokens are blocklist-capable mocks (USDT/USDC-class) that REVERT on transfer to a blocked recipient - a never-failing mock would make the bank never get written and every invariant pass 0==0.
setUp seeds real staked state (4 actors, 1000e18 each), blocks 2 actors on both tokens, opens an Active promo, funds the stable stream and warps 1 day so both bank legs have pending immediately.
Foundry: BankCoverageProofTest.afterInvariant() is a hard tripwire - the run FAILS unless ghost_stableBankEvents>0 AND ghost_promoBankEvents>0.

Medusa: property_neverBanked probe (kept commented) was enabled once and FAILED within seconds (StableClaimFailed(0xA1) + PromoClaimFailed(...,0xA1)), proving the bank path is reachable under Medusa and the passing properties are not vacuous.
